plainTranslation: A's drive meets B's feelings. The trine lets them flow together easily.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
This person may stir something in you without making you feel unsafe. They can bring out a more honest, alive version of you, but it does not have to feel like a battle. Around them, you may find it easier to say what you feel, act on what matters, or stop sitting on something that needs your attention.

There is a good kind of responsiveness here. If you are upset, they may not freeze or disappear. If something matters to you, they may take it seriously. You can feel supported by their presence because they do not just listen from a distance. They seem willing to meet the feeling and do something with it.

When this works, comfort and heat can sit together. You may feel wanted without feeling pressured. You may feel protected without feeling controlled. The connection can make both people a little braver with their feelings, not because anyone is forcing it, but because the energy between you makes honesty feel possible.

The only real risk is letting this good rhythm go unused. Because it is easier than the harder Moon-Mars contacts, you may not notice how much it helps. The support is there, but it still needs somewhere to go.

Use it. Say what you feel. Act on the care. Let the trust between you become something you actually build with.
